videos.title: Makosa Ni Yangu
videos.description:
A young woman leaves her impoverished village for a better life in the city, only to fall in love with a millionaire who hides a dark, abusive nature. Forcing her to choose between enduring his cruelty or returning to a life of poverty.
An Original Philit Productions Film. 
Featuring Melissa Lesilale, Pascal Tokodi, Ms. Brenda Michelle, Beatrice Beats, Kamuyu and Brian Obra

videos.title: 2 Asunder
videos.description:
2 ASUNDER is a 90-minute Kenyan thriller feature film on FAMILY, LOVE, SECRETS and BETRAYAL. The story revolves around a blushing bride, a determined groom, a treacherous best man and an overbearing matriarch, fighting against a ticking clock of deep dark secrets that threaten to end this wealthy family.
Featuring Ciku Muchiri, Bruce Makau, Kevin K1 Maina, Sanaipei Tande

videos.title: Young and Stupid
videos.description: Meet our heroine, a dedicated single mom who worked her wings off as an air hostess to support her kids!  Between taking loans and juggling mom duties, she was soaring high—until she crash-landed into an online romance with Mr. Perfect (or so she thought ). After meeting this “gentleman” on social media, sparks flew, and so did her common sense. But wait—plot twist! Not only did Romeo vanish into thin air, but he also scammed her BFF. You can imagine the drama that followed. Tune in to this wild story of love, lies, and jetlag, and remember folks, always fasten your emotional seatbelts before dating online!
